capabilities: Preview a PDF's comments and replies before export
Write a Markdown review note beside the PDF
Link each comment to its source PDF page
Filter comments by author and saved date (Pro)
Batch-export a folder of PDFs to one note each (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a PDF export of notes; it extracts comments and replies from PDFs into a Markdown note.
extras: Freemium: free mode exports the active PDF only; Pro (author/date filters and folder export) requires a $5/month or $15 GitHub Sponsors payment. Sign-in uses the GitHub device flow and stores the token via Obsidian's secret storage. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. The README lists untested environments (mobile, Windows/Linux desktop, password-protected PDFs, scanned OCR).
problem: Obsidian can display PDFs but offers no way to pull their embedded annotation discussions out as review notes alongside project notes.

relations.evidence: The active PDF command reads the local PDF with the PDF.js library supplied by Obsidian.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: PDF comment export tool that turns a PDF's native review comments and reply threads into a new Markdown note in the vault.
